articles.summary: FAIRFAX, VA / October 7, 2026 / WidePoint Corporation (NYSE American: WYY), a leading provider of Secure Mobile Management Solutions, will be attending the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event from October 19-21, 2026 at the Luxe Sunset Blvd Hotel in Los Angeles, CA. WidePoint management is scheduled to present on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 4:00 p.m.
articles.title: WidePoint to Present at the LD Micro 20 th Annual Main Event on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time
